page.title: Correlation rules
page.description: Cross-source threshold rules, evaluated at the end of each federated search.

betaNotice.title: Beta: evaluation is not continuous
betaNotice.body: A rule only runs when a federated search finishes, and only over its results. No search, no detection. Do not rely on this as your only coverage.

feedback.toggleDisabled: Rule "{{name}}" disabled. It stops generating detections within 1 collection cycle.

createCard.title: New rule
createCard.description: Configure the correlation criteria applied to the results of each completed federated search.

catalogCard.title: Rule catalog
catalogCard.description: The platform's correlation rules. Enabled ones join the next federated search.

search.placeholder: Search by name, description or group-by field…

toggle.tooltipInflight: Stops generating new detections within 1 collection cycle. Does not remove detections already created.
toggle.tooltipDefault: Stops being evaluated on the next federated search.

empty.title: No correlation rules
empty.description: Create rules to detect cross-source patterns and automatically generate detections.

deleteDialog.title: Remove correlation rule
deleteDialog.description: Delete the rule {{name}}? Future detections generated by it will stop.

inflight.notEvaluatedTooltip: Enabled in-flight rule that does NOT enter the evaluation cycle. Two possible causes: it fell above the per-cycle rule cap (the cut is by ascending id, so the newest ones drop first), or its filter (where) does not compile. The notice above the table says which one, and how many rules.

timestamp.label: Timestamp field
timestamp.helperText: Field the window uses. Without it the window is off and every event counts.

validation.timestampRequired: Required when there is a window. Without it the window is ignored

description.placeholder: Context and purpose of the rule

groupBy.helperText: Event field used to group occurrences within the window.

whereFilter.heading: Filters (where)
whereFilter.empty: No filter. The rule evaluates every event.

preview.heading: Test against samples
preview.description: Runs the rule over a real sample for the chosen vendor and event type. Nothing is saved.

vendor.label: Vendor
vendor.helperText: Required. The sample is indexed by vendor + event type.
vendor.loadError: Could not load active integrations. Enter the vendor manually.

eventType.label: Event type
eventType.helperText: Required. The sample is indexed by vendor + event type.
eventType.emptyForVendor: No event type cataloged for this vendor. Enter it manually.

disabledReason.noWhere: Add at least one filter (where) to test.
disabledReason.noVendorOrEventType: Choose vendor and event type to test.

freshness.unknown: Could not determine the samples' time window.
freshness.staleWarning: The newest sample is more than {{days}} day(s) old. The reservoir does not expire on its own, so the integration may be stopped.

summary.matched: {{matched}} of {{total}} sample(s) matched the full rule

empty.title: No samples
empty.description: No sampled events yet for this vendor and type. Check that the integration is sending data.

unavailable.title: Telemetry unavailable
unavailable.description: This does not mean the rule would not match: try again.

invalid.title: Invalid rule
invalid.description: This rule does not compile and would never be evaluated.

reason.bad_json: The filter (where) has an invalid shape. Review field, operator and value on each row.
reason.empty_where: The rule has no filter (where). Add at least one before testing.
reason.unknown_op: One of the operators used isn't supported by the correlation engine.
reason.over_cap: The rule has more filters than the correlation engine supports. Reduce the number of clauses.

requestError.title: Failed to test the rule
requestError.description: Could not complete the test call.

clauses.heading: Verdict by clause
clauses.pathNotFound: Field "{{path}}" not found in any sample. The path may be wrong.
clauses.pathFoundNoMatch: Field exists in {{resolved}} of {{total}} sample(s), but the value doesn't match the operator.

truncated.title: Enabled rules that are not being evaluated
truncated.description: {{truncated}} of {{total}} enabled in-flight rule(s) fell OUTSIDE the per-cycle cap of {{cap}}. The cut is by ascending id: the dropped ones are the NEWEST, including the rule you just created. They show as enabled in the list and never fire.

uncompilable.description: {{uncompilable}} rule(s) are INSIDE the cap and still get dropped when the cycle loads them, because their filter (where) does not compile. Raising the cap does not fix this cause: fix the filter.

disabled.title: In-flight evaluation is switched off
disabled.description: The per-cycle rule cap is 0 in this environment — that is a kill switch, not an absence of rules. The {{total}} enabled in-flight rule(s) are still saved, and none of them is evaluated while the cap is 0.

limits.capSource: Cap as read by the API process: {{cap}} per cycle, against {{creationCap}} for creation. If the variable is declared only on the workers, the collector may be cutting at a different number.

loadError.title: Could not read the evaluation caps
loadError.description: Without them this screen cannot explain why an enabled rule never fires. Detail: {{message}}

metrics.heading: Counters for rule {{name}}
metrics.window: {{hours}} h window, read from the observability store.
metrics.description: Window read from the observability store.

loadError.title: Failed to read the counters
loadError.description: Could not complete the counter read for this rule.

unavailable.title: Read unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer. The dashes below mean unknown, never zero: the rule may have fired and the read may have failed.

metrics.unknownTooltip: This series could not be read. This is NOT zero: the rule may have fired and the read may have failed.

matches.label: Matches
matches.hint: Events that matched. It can exceed the number of detections: dedup and the key cap sit in between.

overflow.label: Dropped by key cap (overflow)
overflow.zero: No key dropped in this window.
overflow.hint: Matches lost because the cycle blew past the cap on distinct keys.

cardinality.title: group_by cardinality
cardinality.description: High matches WITH high overflow diagnose the cardinality of {{field}}, not a bug: the cycle caps distinct keys per rule and drops the excess. Lower the field's cardinality, or read matches as a floor, never as a total.

errors.heading: Errors attributed to this rule
errors.empty: No error reason is attributed to this rule.
errors.footnote: Only reasons attributable to a rule show up here; failures that happen before a rule is picked have no owner and stay out.

reason.group_by_unresolved: group_by field not found in the event
reason.key_cap: Cap on distinct keys reached in the cycle
reason.flush_lost: Counter lost while flushing the cycle
